The Power of Crypto

TBC is a streamlined ETF-style crypto token tracking the top 10 digital assets by market cap. With dynamic rebalancing and a transparent structure, it simplifies diversified crypto investing-giving users reliable, real-time exposure to leading coins in one smart, unified asset.

Backed by Top 10 Coins

TBC is backed by the top 10 cryptocurrencies by market cap, offering smart exposure through a proportionally weighted token. With an adaptive system that aligns with market shifts in real time, TBC makes diversified investing simple – no complex portfolio management required.

TBC - The Token That Works for All!

Invest smart, trade better, grow together

TBC for Retail Investors

TBC offers a smart investment solution, providing diversified exposure to the Top 10 Coins without the complexity of managing individual assets. Instead of trying to time the market, investors can hold TBC as a long-term asset and capitalize on its steady growth over time.

TBC for Professional Traders

TBC serves as a dynamic benchmark for the top cryptocurrencies.
By tracking market shifts, experienced traders can identify overvalued assets, short them strategically, and hedge with TBC, ensuring balanced exposure and risk management in volatile conditions.

TBC for Institutional Investors

As an ETF crypto investment, TBC offers institutions a structured and reliable approach to market exposure, providing transparent, liquid, and risk-adjusted investment opportunities designed for large-scale investments and portfolio diversification.
